keySpace.ordering: Unicode code point sort of flattened en.json dotted string leaf keys
keySpace.hashEncoding: sha256 of UTF8 compact JSON (ensure_ascii=false); keySet hashes sorted dotted keys; orderedContent hashes [[key,value],...] sorted by Unicode code point.
keySpace.maskEncoding: base64 of ceil(14003/8) bytes; canonical key i is bit(i%8) of byte floor(i/8), least significant bit first; tail bits zero. present and equal-English masks reconstruct exact key membership against pinned en.json. Flattening uses nested object keys joined by dot; no builtin object keys contain dot/colon/prototype-sensitive names.

localization.content: No duplicate object keys, nonstring/empty leaves, target-only keys, interpolation-token multiset mismatches, unmatched braces, nesting references, or formatted/unescaped interpolation tokens in these seven actual resources. Five HTML-like English entries contain literal CLI placeholders (<host>, <reachable-host>, <worktree-path>), not rendering directives; sinks retain escaping ownership. Identical-English target values may be brands/technical literals and are not classified as untranslated.
localization.renderer: Eager en-runtime-required; lazy es/fr/ja/ko/zh; unknown loader callback(null,false), failed import callback(Error,false); fallback en, partialBundledLanguages, namespace translation, interpolation.escapeValue=false, React suspense disabled. init promise is discarded. translate forwards caller options then overwrites defaultValue with branded fallback; no equivalent main empty/nonstring guard. Locale setting resolves plugin resource or en if unavailable and awaits change only when different.
localization.main: English bundled resource is {}, so English uses inline defaults; same five lazy JSON imports. ensureMainI18n sets initialized after awaited init without shared in-flight promise; main system locale catches app.getLocale failure to en. translateMain before initialization returns branded fallback without interpolation; after init nonstring/empty result returns fallback. Plugin setter skips identical array identity.
localization.selection: Normalize trim/lower/underscore, supported primary language; zh-TW/zh-HK/zh-Hant return en, other zh returns zh, unknown returns en. Explicit saved setting overrides OS; renderer uses navigator.language and main app.getLocale for system. Unknown setting normalizes system; syntactically valid plugin identifier survives selection. Provider waits for settings, records requested locale, registers packs before language effect, resets request marker on packs, and discards changeLanguage promise; no local cancellation/generation fence for language effects.
localization.plugin: Resource language encodes each identifier UTF16 unit as four hex digits. Registration guard checks plugin-prefixed id, matching encoded resource language and string pluginKey/locale plus catalog guard; this is registration shape, not provider authorization or full UI-language-regex revalidation. Plain nested objects only, depth16, 20000 keys including containers, keys1–128 with no dots/control/prototype keys, strings<=8192 (empty allowed), seen-object rejection, protected plugin-settings namespace except accepted chrome allowlist. No core-key/interpolation matching in registration guard. Store uses generation to discard stale list responses, invalid/nonarray/error/API-absent -> loaded empty list, single change subscription; setters remove old bundles then deep overwrite current bundles, assume typed/validated input.
localization.brandingAndCache: Case-sensitive word-boundary Orca -> Drogon transforms catalog strings and inline fallback before interpolation, leaving interpolated user values unchanged. Pseudo en-XA only brackets nonempty not-already-bracketed strings; no real expansion/RTL policy. Localized catalog cache keys only by language, so same-language pack-content replacement does not invalidate a defined cached value.
localization.lookup: Read installed i18next26.3.1 ESM as text, explicitly not pinned tracked-source authentication: defaults dot key/colon namespace, translation namespace, returnNull=false, returnEmptyString=true. Per language candidate keys include plural/context/zero variants before base; hierarchy then fallback en; after resource misses caller defaultValue/suffix defaults then key. count provided and not string enables Intl.PluralRules cardinal/ordinal selection (not finite-number validation), language fallback may recalculate category; invalid locale falls toward primary/dummy rule. All catalog plural keys are _one/_other: 19 families en/runtime,18 fr,10 other targets; no zero/two/few/many/ordinal keys. Locale CLDR categories may exceed supplied suffixes, so base/English/default fallback remains meaningful.
localization.interpolation: Runtime disables HTML escape; {{name}} substitution uses values/options, nonstrings stringify, missing variable generally remains literal under skipOnVariables while explicitly own undefined can produce empty text, replacements capped1000. No actual catalog $t nesting/format/unescape tokens found; caller options remain a trusted extension seam. Intl formatting uses plugin declared locale or active language only if supportedLocalesOf returns it, otherwise en, catching invalid tags.
localization.generation: Generator keeps plural keys, no-static-reference/dynamic-fallback keys, multiple/different fallback keys; drops a key only when observed literal-reference fallbacks agree with catalog. Sorted nested output; validation rejects missing required or contradictory values but permits superfluous consistent entries. Current2588 subset entries all equal full English; no all-source extraction or generation executed, so actual-caller freshness remains an unrun check.
localization.verification: Verifier scans renderer/main extensions excluding tests/specs/assets, recognizes literal keys by final identifier/property name rather than symbol binding, accepts sparse target catalogs, rejects target-only keys, interpolation mismatches and policy regressions; --fix can write missing English from consistent literal fallbacks but never translate/remove target entries.
